title: Palermo Stone shows pre-dynastic Egyptian civilization

tellings.quote: And I believe it's the Polarmo stone that shows that there's Egyptian civilization that dates back far before the dynastic period.

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who studies the Egyptian pyramids, told podcast host Jesse Michels about the Palermo Stone, an ancient carved slab that lists early Egyptian rulers. Drumm says he believes the stone shows Egyptian civilization going back long before the age of the pharaohs. If so, Egypt's history would be far older than usually told.
